verdict.rationale: ZCode is an AI coding workbench with a terminal agent and multi-agent collaboration that plans, executes and verifies goals. Tasks can also be triggered remotely via WeChat, Feishu or Telegram. Community users describe prompting it and say it 'works pretty well', with strong HCI praise, though one user reports frequent API connection failures on prompts. Missing for 10: first-party documentation explicitly describing the natural-language command interface in depth, and consistent reliability of prompt execution.
